tasks.title: Anthropic SSE parser + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/AIClient+Anthropic.swift as actor extension on AIClient. Add `static func parseAnthropicSSEEvent(eventName: String, data: Data) -> LocalStreamChunk?` (reuse LocalStreamChunk from AIClient+Local.swift). Handle event types: message_start (no-op → nil), content_block_start (nil), content_block_delta (parse data JSON `{"type":"content_block_delta","delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"..."}}` and return LocalStreamChunk(text: extracted, done: false); if delta.type != text_delta return nil), content_block_stop (nil), message_delta (nil), message_stop (LocalStreamChunk(text: "", done: true)). tasks.title: ChatStorage (SQLite) + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/ChatStorage.swift as `actor ChatStorage`. `import SQLite3`. Owns lazy `OpaquePointer?` per repoID. Public API: init(baseDirectory: URL? = nil) (nil = default ~/Library/Application Support/Zion/chats), `static func repoID(for url: URL) -> String` (SHA256 of absolute path, first 16 hex chars), `func loadThreads(repoID:) async throws -> [ChatThread]` (returns ordered by updated_at desc), `func saveThread(_:repoID:) async throws` (upsert by id), `func loadMessages(threadID:repoID:) async throws -> [ChatMessage]` (ordered by created_at asc), `func appendMessage(_:threadID:repoID:) async throws`, `func updateMessage(_:repoID:) async throws`, `func deleteThread(_ id:repoID:) async throws`, `func renameThread(_ id:title:repoID:) async throws`. private func connection(for repoID) opens DB lazily, runs `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;` + the schema CREATE statements (threads, messages, idx_messages_thread_created). Throw ChatStorageError.sqlite(code: Int32, message: String) on any sqlite3 failure. Create Tests/ZionTests/ChatStorageTests.swift using temp directory via baseDirectory init: testSchemaCreatedOnFirstOpen, testThreadInsertLoadRoundTrip, testMessagesPreserveOrder, testDeleteThreadCascadesMessages, testRepoIsolation (two repoIDs are independent).

tasks.title: ChatService multi-thread + persistence + cloud dispatch + tests
tasks.description: Modify Sources/Zion/Services/ChatService.swift: (1) replace `var thread: ChatThread` with `var threads: [ChatThread] = []` + `var activeThreadID: UUID`. Add computed `var thread: ChatThread { get/set }` mapped through threads/activeThreadID for back-compat. (2) Inject `@ObservationIgnored private let storage: ChatStorage` + `@ObservationIgnored private let repoID: String` in init. (3) On init Task { await reloadFromStorage() } — load threads, if none create one default. On error: log + lastPersistenceError + L10n chat.persistence.error; continue volatile. (4) New methods createThread / deleteThread / renameThread / selectThread — mutate threads then fire-and-forget storage op. deleteThread of active picks next-most-recent or creates new if none. (5) On send: append user msg; if active thread title equals a defaultTitle pattern, set title to first 60 chars of user msg via renameThread. (6) Dispatch streaming: .local → streamLocalLLM (existing), .openai → streamOpenAI, .anthropic → streamAnthropic, .gemini and .none → existing AIClient.call non-streaming. (7) Streaming consumer: append delta to last assistant message in active thread; debounce persistence via Task keyed by message id at Constants.Timing.chatPersistenceDebounce (500ms); FORCE final flush with is_streaming=0 on stream completion (cancel debounce). Write Tests/ZionTests/ChatServiceMultiThreadTests.swift: testCreateThreadAppendsAndActivates, testSelectThreadSwapsActive, testDeleteActiveThreadSelectsNextOrCreates, testRenameThreadUpdatesTitle, testInitLoadsPersistedThreads (use temp ChatStorage(baseDirectory: tmpdir)).
